subject: Security synthesis & evidence lane — SOC 2, retention, pen test
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finiq.com>; security@finiq.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security synthesis & evidence lane — SOC 2, retention, pen test

Hi Elena / FinIQ security team,

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap and clear next steps so we can get you the right artifacts for your audit and procurement window. High-level takeaways from our call: 

- Primary asks from FinIQ: SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), 3-year audit-log retention plan, DPA adjustments for data residency, and recent pen test summary with remediation evidence.
- Pain: procurement team needs concrete artifacts to clear vendor security gate by 4/22 (internal SLA), and the security committee needs mapping of which logs we capture vs. your retention policy.
- Constraint: FinIQ runs part of their stack in qatar-cloud and requires proof that logs can be exported to an approved archive (S3-compatible) for the 3-year retention window.

Deliverables we committed to:
1) SOC 2 artifacts: redwood-soc2-extract.zip (contains SOC 2 cover letter, trust-service-principles matrix, test-summary). ETA: 04/05 EOD — owner: Alex
2) Audit-log mapping: spreadsheet mapping FinIQ required log types to Redwood audit events + export path (audit-log-mapping.xlsx). ETA: 04/06 — owner: Laura (solutions engineering)
3) DPA redline / template: DPA_template_v2.docx with residency and subprocessing clauses called out. ETA: 04/06 — owner: Alex
4) Pen test summary: redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf + remediation verification notes. ETA: 04/07 — owner: Vivek (security partnerships)

Operational notes / clarifications:
- Log export: we can stream audit logs to an S3-compatible bucket in your VPC; we'll provide exporters and IAM examples.
- Retention verification: we will provide a mapping and a short runbook for how to request on-demand exports for audits.
- DPA: where you requested localized data residency language, we'll provide an option to append a residency rider and sample clause for legal review.

Next/Actions (who & when):
- Alex: upload SOC 2 extract & DPA template to the shared Drive folder and post HubSpot link (by 04/05).
- Laura: produce audit-log mapping spreadsheet and include sample queries for Splunk/ELK (by 04/06).
- Vivek: attach pen-test summary and remediation notes, include vendor name and timeline (by 04/07).
- Elena/FinIQ: confirm whether the export target will be an S3 bucket or an on-prem archive and if there are specific encryption/KMS requirements (reply by 04/07).

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-extract.zip (ZIP), audit-log-mapping.xlsx (XLSX), DPA_template_v2.docx (DOCX), redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (PDF).

Drive folder (incoming): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE
HubSpot deal: HubSpot:Deals/4901

If this list looks right I will start uploading artifacts today and schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the mapping with your security engineer.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

---

From: Elena Rossi <elena@finiq.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finiq.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 17:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Security synthesis & evidence lane — SOC 2, retention, pen test

Alex,

Appreciate the quick recap. That mirrors our notes. A few clarifications before you upload: 

1) SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report and the control mapping (which controls map to our requirements). If you can include a short readme that points our auditors to the relevant pages that would be ideal.
2) Logs: yes, export to an S3-compatible bucket is preferred. Encryption at rest must be customer-managed keys (KMS). We will share an example bucket ARN once procurement confirms.
3) Pen test: we need proof of remediation (tickets or verification steps) and the vendor contact so we can validate scope.

Timeline: procurement target is 04/22 as discussed. If you can get initial artifacts by 04/05–04/07 window that should keep us on track.

Also looping in Amir from our infrastructure team to confirm the bucket/residency details.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Chief Risk Officer
FinIQ

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finiq.com>, security@finiq.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security synthesis & evidence lane — SOC 2, retention, pen test

Hi Elena — thanks. Uploads are live in the Drive folder and I pushed links to the HubSpot deal: HubSpot:Deals/4901

What I uploaded today (04/05):
- redwood-soc2-extract.zip — includes a short README at the top with pointer pages for auditor review (file: README_SOC2.txt).
- DPA_template_v2.docx — highlighted residency clauses.

Remaining items in progress:
- audit-log-mapping.xlsx (Laura) — in progress, ETA 04/06
- redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (Vivek) — in progress, ETA 04/07

Quick answers inline: 
- SOC 2 control mapping: included in README_SOC2.txt inside the ZIP. Let me know if you need a different format (CSV mapping) for your toolchain.
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS; we will provide an example policy and minimal permissions to grant.
- Pen test vendor: Vivek will include vendor contact and a short remediation timeline in the pen-test PDF.

DocuSign: once DPA redline is agreed we can generate a DocuSign link. Preview link will be shared with Elena and procurement.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE
DocuSign preview staging: https://app.docusign.com/link/abc123EXAMPLE

If you confirm the bucket ARN or any additional legal clauses to include in the DPA, we will incorporate them before sending to DocuSign.

Best,
Alex

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@finiq.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security synthesis & evidence lane — SOC 2, retention, pen test

Following up on the audit-log mapping: quick status update for visibility.

- I started the mapping and included three tabs: event-type mapping, export mechanics, and sample Splunk queries.
- For the export mechanics I have two suggested patterns: push-to-s3 from our side (server-side) vs. your pull connector. Push is simpler for immediate compliance; pull gives you direct ownership.
- I will add a short runbook for on-demand export requests (how FinIQ can request a snapshot for audits) and include the retention validation steps.

Vivek — can you confirm the pen-test vendor name so I can cross-reference scope with the event types?

Elena — tagging Amir: Amir, if you can drop the bucket ARN and KMS key id when you have a moment, I will bake that into the examples (or we can use placeholders if you prefer).

ETA: audit-log-mapping.xlsx uploaded by EOD 04/06.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
